Keywords: Care and food for wounded Rus households
RagShortTexts: Rus families sought carers and available remedies for wounds.
Care, food and replacement labor cost resources alongside uncertain remedies.

Woodland households sought people familiar with remedies and care, prayed and asked kin for help. Gathering materials, watching patients and providing food, water and warmth took time. Recurring illness further strained labor and stores. Wounded travelers needed carrying, watching and shelter, with return depending on injury and care. Remedies did not replace food and shelter, and companions shared loads.
